title: Apple launches HomeView hub to boost Siri AI in smart homes
title_zh: 苹果推出HomeView智能家居中枢，升级Siri AI

image.credit: Photo by Laurenz Heymann on Unsplash
image.author: Laurenz Heymann

lead: Apple has introduced a new smart home device called HomeView, which serves as a hub for other gadgets. The launch highlights an upgraded version of Siri AI, as Apple tries to catch up with rivals like Amazon and OpenAI.
lead_zh: 苹果推出了一款名为HomeView的新智能家居设备，可作为其他智能设备的控制中枢。此次发布重点展示了升级版Siri AI，苹果正试图追赶亚马逊和OpenAI等竞争对手。

preview_zh: 苹果周二发布了一系列新的智能家居产品，其中包括一款名为HomeView的类iPad设备。它可以挂在墙上或放在桌面上，作为其他智能家居设备的控制中枢。该设备起售价299美元，配有7英寸屏幕和面部识别功能，将于下个月开始发货。今天开始接受预订，预计11月13日起可购买。
paragraphs: Apple on Tuesday unveiled a new line of smart home products, including an iPad-like device called HomeView. It can be hung on walls or placed on tabletops, acting as a hub for other smart home gadgets. The device starts at $299, features a 7-inch screen and face recognition, and will begin shipping next month. Preorders start today, with availability expected from November 13.

HomeView will help users control doorbells, thermostats, and smart locks, and it showcases Apple's AI-upgraded Siri assistant. The new Siri is described as more capable and conversational, using information from personal apps like Messages and Calendar to provide more relevant answers. Apple says it is powered by Apple Intelligence, drawing on personal context from your iPhone while keeping information private and secure.

The launch comes as Apple tries to fend off competition from traditional rivals like Amazon, which has invested heavily in Echo speakers and Ring doorbells, as well as newer AI upstarts like OpenAI that have hardware ambitions. Apple also updated its HomePod smart speaker and Apple TV devices, and introduced accessories from LG and Schneider Electric, including doorbells, cameras, thermostats, and a smart lock.

The new devices are managed in the Apple Home app. However, HomeView will not be sold in the European Union because Siri AI remains unavailable there due to EU regulations. Analysts note that Apple has faced hurdles in making its devices work with third-party gadgets and in improving Siri's ability to give useful answers.
paragraphs_zh: 苹果周二发布了一系列新的智能家居产品，其中包括一款名为HomeView的类iPad设备。它可以挂在墙上或放在桌面上，作为其他智能家居设备的控制中枢。该设备起售价299美元，配有7英寸屏幕和面部识别功能，将于下个月开始发货。今天开始接受预订，预计11月13日起可购买。
HomeView将帮助用户控制门铃、恒温器和智能锁，并展示了苹果AI升级版Siri助手。新版Siri被描述为更强大、更善于对话，能利用Messages和Calendar等个人应用中的信息提供更相关的答案。苹果表示，它由Apple Intelligence驱动，利用iPhone上的个人情境信息，同时保持信息私密安全。
此次发布正值苹果试图抵御传统竞争对手如亚马逊（后者在Echo音箱和Ring门铃上投入巨资）以及像OpenAI这样有硬件野心的新兴AI公司。苹果还更新了HomePod智能音箱和Apple TV设备，并推出了来自LG和施耐德电气的配件，包括门铃、摄像头、恒温器和智能锁。
新设备通过Apple Home应用进行管理。然而，HomeView不会在欧盟销售，因为由于欧盟法规，Siri AI在那里仍不可用。分析人士指出，苹果在让设备兼容第三方产品以及提升Siri提供有用答案的能力方面一直面临障碍。

body_original:
Apple unveils new smart home devices that showcase upgraded Siri AI
New products from Apple include the HomeView, an iPad-like device that acts as a hub for other smart home gadgets
Apple on Tuesday began showing off a ⁠new round of smart home products, including an iPad-like device dubbed the HomeView, meant to hang on walls or perch on tabletops ⁠and act as a hub for other smart home devices.
The HomeView device starts at $299 and will begin shipping next month. It will feature a 7in screen and face recognition, will help users ⁠control doorbells, thermostats and smart locks in a market where Apple has tinkered for a decade without major success. The device will also showcase Apple’s AI-upgraded Siri virtual ​assistant.
Preorders begin today and the devices are expected to be available starting 13 November.
Apple is launching these products as it ⁠tries to fend off competition from rivals, including traditional competitors like Amazon – which has invested heavily in ​its Echo speakers and Ring doorbells and ‌last week launched premium tablets – as well as newer AI upstarts like OpenAI that have hardware ambitions of their own.
Apple’s HomeView launch was accompanied by updates to its HomePod smart speaker and Apple TV devices. It also introduced a range of ‌accessories, including doorbells, cameras and thermostats, made by LG and Schneider Electric and designed with help from Apple.
The new line of devices are accessible and managed in the Apple home app. The accessories include a Schneider smart thermostat and LG home security devices including indoor and various outdoor cameras including a doorbell camera and floodlight camera as well as a smart lock. The lock can be unlocked using the Apple home app.
The HomeView device will not be sold in the European Union, because Siri AI remains unavailable there due to EU regulations, Apple said.
Apple first released its Home app to control smart gadgets in 2016, ⁠with HomePod smart speakers following in 2018, but those offerings are competing with ​Alphabet’s Google Home speakers and ​Amazon’s Echo line. Analysts said ​two major hurdles for Apple were making its devices work with a ​variety of third-party gadgets and ‌the limited ability ​of Siri to ​give useful answers.
The HomeView device includes a revamped version of Siri AI, the company announced. An Apple press release described the new version of Siri as more capable and conversational, using information from personal apps like Messages and Calendar to provide more relevant answers.
“It’s powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI at its core, drawing on personal context from your iPhone to help you find what you need and get more done, all while keeping everyone’s information private and secure,” the release said.
